title: Transit Systems
scope: Covers FTA NTD agency-level ridership, operating cost, and farebox recovery for large U.S. transit systems, including a Massachusetts comparison that does not duplicate DL-03's MBTA-only views.
exclusions: Does not cover MBTA mode-by-mode reliability or The RIDE (those stay on DL-03), capital budgets, or fare advice.
